'''2008 Texas Match Play Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event in Texas in 2008. The Players Committee's decklist PDF ([[:File:2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2.pdf]]) holds eight Day 2 deck printouts (printed 29 April 2008) that give only the players' first names (Greg, Joe, Kevin and Scott), so they are not yet published as decklists here.

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Texas
* '''Dates:''' 2008
* '''Winner:''' —
